fusions.name: Gnawing Cloud
fusions.desc: The cloud around you bites every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 4 damage, and you restore 2 health.

fusions.name: Strip the Stalk
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a sting that deals 22 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Darkened Sky
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm that deals 4 damage every second to enemies within 3 tiles, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Field Left Bare
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
